areas.label: NSFW
areas.description: Workflows installed from a folder, not shipped with the app.

modules.label: SDXL Batch
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: SDXL with an upscale pass and a face pass. The prompt is built from four parts.

modules.label: Klein NSFW
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: Text to image on a Flux.2 Klein finetune. One sampler pass, sized from an aspect ratio rather than raw pixels.

modules.label: Klein NSFW - Redraw
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: HIDDEN. Denoise trades composition against change on one scalar, and on this checkpoint there was no setting that did both. Kontext Edit does the same job by conditioning on the picture instead. Set enabled back to true to try it again - nothing else was removed.

modules.label: Realism Converter
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: Turns an existing picture photographic in two passes: Flux.2 Klein rebuilds it, then Z-Image Turbo refines at low denoise.

modules.label: Inpaint Pro
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: Repaints part of a picture and finds the part itself. Mask edges are matted with VITMatte, which transformers fetches once on first use; set Mask edges to GuidedFilter to avoid that download.

modules.label: Kontext Edit
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: Change a picture by describing the change. Kontext puts the image in the conditioning rather than the latent, so identity, pose and light survive an edit.

modules.label: Wan 2.2 Text to Video
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation
custom_nodes.note: RIFE VFI - doubles the frames between what the sampler made

modules.notes: A clip from a prompt on Wan 2.2 14B. The LoRA stack the graph carries is left as saved - the four-step distill LoRA in it is what makes four steps work. Opens at 720: measured on a 24 GB card, the same clip took 360s at 720 and 1134s at 1024.

modules.label: Wan 2.2 Image to Video
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: Animates a picture you supply. Same two-pass Wan 2.2 setup as the text one.

modules.label: Wan 2.2 First to Last Frame
modules.family_description: Extra workflows, installed from a folder rather than shipped with the app.
modules.notes: A clip between two pictures. Six steps rather than four, and it needs the CLIP-Vision encoder as well.
